title: robots.txt 真实解析与抓取许可判定
expected_output:
=== robots.txt 内容 ===
  User-agent: BadBot
  Disallow: /
  (空行)
  User-agent: *
  Disallow: /private/
  Disallow: /tmp
  Allow: /private/ok
  Crawl-delay: 2
  Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml

=== 判定结果(User-agent: *) ===
  允许     https://example.com/
  允许     https://example.com/public/a.html
  禁止     https://example.com/private/a.html
  允许     https://example.com/private/ok/b.html
  禁止     https://example.com/tmp
  禁止     https://example.com/tmp/x
  禁止     https://example.com/tmpabc

=== 三条规则要点 ===
1. 最长匹配优先: /private/a.html 命中 Disallow:/private/, /private/ok/b.html 命中更长的 Allow:/private/ok
2. 前缀匹配而非目录匹配: /tmpabc 命中 Disallow:/tmp (字符串前缀, 不带斜杠)
3. Crawl-delay 生效: 2 秒 -> 同域名两次请求至少间隔这么久

=== 另一个 UA 的差异化规则 ===
BadBot 访问 / : False
* 访问 /     : True
同一路径不同 UA 结论可以不同 —— 但伪装成别的 UA 规避限制属于不合规做法
code:
# robots.txt 真实解析与抓取许可判定
from urllib import robotparser

ROBOTS = [
    "User-agent: BadBot",
    "Disallow: /",
    "",
    "User-agent: *",
    "Disallow: /private/",
    "Disallow: /tmp",
    "Allow: /private/ok",
    "Crawl-delay: 2",
    "Sitemap: https://example.com/sitemap.xml",
]

rp = robotparser.RobotFileParser()
rp.parse(ROBOTS)

print("=== robots.txt 内容 ===")
for line in ROBOTS:
    print("  " + line if line else "  (空行)")
print("")

print("=== 判定结果(User-agent: *) ===")
targets = [
    "https://example.com/",
    "https://example.com/public/a.html",
    "https://example.com/private/a.html",
    "https://example.com/private/ok/b.html",
    "https://example.com/tmp",
    "https://example.com/tmp/x",
    "https://example.com/tmpabc",
]
for u in targets:
    ok = rp.can_fetch("*", u)
    print("  %-6s %s" % ("允许" if ok else "禁止", u))

print("")
print("=== 三条规则要点 ===")
print("1. 最长匹配优先: /private/a.html 命中 Disallow:/private/, /private/ok/b.html 命中更长的 Allow:/private/ok")
print("2. 前缀匹配而非目录匹配: /tmpabc 命中 Disallow:/tmp (字符串前缀, 不带斜杠)")
print("3. Crawl-delay 生效:", rp.crawl_delay("*"), "秒 -> 同域名两次请求至少间隔这么久")

print("")
print("=== 另一个 UA 的差异化规则 ===")
print("BadBot 访问 / :", rp.can_fetch("BadBot", "https://example.com/"))
print("* 访问 /     :", rp.can_fetch("*", "https://example.com/"))
print("同一路径不同 UA 结论可以不同 —— 但伪装成别的 UA 规避限制属于不合规做法")
